div.div: Network Account: One Private Doorway to On-Prem

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 208px; height: 1px; padding-top: 696px; margin-left: 23px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Flows:
1. Direct Connect: the primary private link from Queens
2. Encrypted VPN: the backup path from Queens and Westchester
3. Private path between on-prem and the Production account
4. Private path between on-prem and the Backup account (if the client approves)
5. Link to the DR gateway in us- east-2 (needs client approval)
6. Flow logs go to the Log Archive account, which nobody here can change
7. Findings and alerts go to the Security / Audit account
8. Restricted staff manage the network, under approval
NOTE:
Only Production and Backup attach. Non-Production, Client-facing, and IT Tooling have no link to the shared network.
